risks.title: Global Economic Conditions and Industry Cyclicality
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the risk factors (Item 1A), the language covers major elements such as recession, inflation, tariffs, and interest rates. This risk is fundamental to demand for the company's products.

risks.title: Pricing Pressure and Technological Competition
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A and linked to the pace of technological change, a key factor in the industrial technology sector. Pricing pressure is a direct consequence.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks and IT Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified in Item 1A with emphasis on the potential impact on IT infrastructure. The specific mention of AI-related threats indicates potentially heightened severity.

risks.title: Geopolitical Instability and Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned with emphasis on military conflicts, economic instability, and regulatory uncertainty in China. These external factors can disrupt global operations.

risks.title: Acquisition and Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: TE Connectivity undertakes strategic acquisitions (Richards Manufacturing for 2.3 Bn in 2025, Schaffner in 2024). Risks related to integration, unrealized synergies, and financial impacts are material.
